item.title: William of Orange, Henry VIII and Shakespeare all fell under the spell of posey rings — once England's most popular item of jewellery
item.description: The beautifully crafted messages inscribed inside posy rings are among the most touchingly romantic lines in history. Jonathan Self recounts their history.

item.title: Amanda Seyfried's new film answers the question: Where did the viral Instagram Shaker kitchen come from — and how is it linked to Quakerism?
item.description: 'The Testament of Ann Lee follows' the founder of Shakerism. But how did a devotional sect come to influence a major kitchen interior design trend?

item.title: It's fashion, darling — and the Country Life Quiz of the Day, February 20, 2026
item.description: It's a fashion-themed quiz to end the week and celebrate London Fashion Week which is now in full flow.

item.title: A 350-year-old estate in Barbados that’s hosted royals and Helen Mirren, furnished with 400 potted plants
item.description: Oh, and it comes with 400 pot plants.

item.title: Intrepid, enterprising, dedicated: The new generation of nursery owners creating the flowers we'll be enjoying for decades to come
item.description: David Carver is typical of the new generation of nursery owners, determined to save historic collections and produce new hybrids. John Hoyland paid him a visit to find out more; photographs by Clive Nichols.

item.title: Hôtel du Couvent: This former convent on the French Riviera has rekindled the rules of luxury
item.description: Hôtel du Couvent has none of the excess that the French Riviera has become known for in recent years, says James Fisher.

item.title: Pushing back against a culture of disposability: The enduring importance of craft

item.description: Lotte Brundle meets the 85-year-old fashion designer in her vibrant apartment above the Fashion and Textile Museum in London.

item.title: Home is where the hearth is: Five picture-perfect cottages with glorious fireplaces
item.description: An imposing inglenook fireplace can be the natural heart of a home — and a characterful draw for buyers — as it radiates warmth and coaxes company towards that comforting glow.

item.title: 'I have never ceased talking of the beauty of Ampthill': The tale of one of Britain's best-loved country houses
